title: The neighbour who remembers me
subtitle: A greeting becomes a small invitation.
ending: I leave for school with a Saturday invitation and a way to ask for help. Ms Lin knows my name now. The next greeting will be easier.

scenes.title: Someone knows my face
scenes.speaker: lin
paragraphs: I step into the courtyard before school. My bag catches the door; Ms Lin, the neighbour I have nodded to all week, smiles at my noisy entrance. Today she waits for more than a nod.

line.english: Hello! Do you live here too?
line.pinyin: nǐ hǎo ！ nǐ yě zhù zhè lǐ ma ？

scenes.clue: Answer her question about where you live.

choices.label: Answer her question about where you live.
choices.hint: Listen again and look for the part that answers the question.

responseLine.zh: 我也住这里。很高兴认识你！
responseLine.english: I live here too. Nice to meet you!
responseLine.pinyin: wǒ yě zhù zhè lǐ 。 hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ ！

options.simplePinyin: duì wǒ yě zhù zhè lǐ
options.richPinyin: duì wǒ yě zhù zhè lǐ

options.feedback: She is asking where you live, rather than where you drink tea.
options.simplePinyin: wǒ zài zhè lǐ hē chá 。
options.richPinyin: wǒ zài zhè lǐ hē chá 。

options.feedback: Look for 住: she is asking about living here.
options.simplePinyin: nǐ shì wǒ de lǎo shī 。
options.richPinyin: nǐ shì wǒ de lǎo shī 。

scenes.title: The books give me away
scenes.speaker: lin
paragraphs: I introduce myself as David. Ms Lin repeats my name carefully, then notices the books in my bag. One clear sentence about my work will do.

line.english: David, what do you teach at school?
line.pinyin: dà wèi ， nǐ zài xué xiào jiào shén me ？

scenes.clue: Tell her which subject you teach.

choices.label: Tell her which subject you teach.
choices.hint: Listen again and look for the part that answers the question.

responseLine.english: English! You are an English teacher.
responseLine.pinyin: yīng yǔ ！ nǐ shì yīng yǔ lǎo shī 。

options.simplePinyin: wǒ zài xué xiào jiào yīng yǔ
options.richPinyin: wǒ zài xué xiào jiào yīng yǔ

options.feedback: 学 means to study; listen for 教 in her question.

options.richPinyin: wǒ zài xué xiào xué zhōng wén 。

options.richPinyin: wǒ xīng qī liù yǒu kōng 。

scenes.title: An invitation across the courtyard
scenes.speaker: lin
paragraphs: Across the courtyard, Ms Zhou sets cups on a table. Ms Lin waves, then takes out her calendar. I would like to accept her invitation; first I need to catch which day she means.

line.zh: 你星期六有空吗？我们一起喝茶吧。
line.english: Are you free on Saturday? Let’s have tea together.
line.pinyin: nǐ xīng qī liù yǒu kōng ma ？ wǒ men yì qǐ hē chá ba 。

scenes.clue: Listen for the day she suggests, then accept for that day.

choices.label: Listen for the day she suggests, then accept for that day.

simple.english: Okay, I am free on Saturday.

rich.english: Okay, I am free on Saturday.

scenes.title: One more thing before school
scenes.speaker: lin
paragraphs: Ms Lin adds a question just as a scooter passes. I catch “Chinese,” but not enough to answer confidently. I can ask for help and still keep this conversation going.

line.english: Do you study Chinese every day?
line.pinyin: nǐ měi tiān dōu xué zhōng wén ma ？

scenes.clue: Say you did not understand, then politely ask her to repeat.

choices.label: Say you did not understand, then politely ask her to repeat.

simple.english: I did not understand. Please say it again.

rich.english: I did not understand. Please say it again.

choices.hint: Start with 我没听懂. 请 introduces the request; 再 goes before 说.

responseLine.english: Of course. Do you study Chinese every day?
responseLine.pinyin: hǎo 。 nǐ měi tiān dōu xué zhōng wén ma ？

aside.question: Recall this moment
aside.answer: Ms Lin adds a question just as a scooter passes. I catch “Chinese,” but not enough to answer confidently. I can ask for help and still keep this conversation going.

title: A weekend plan, almost
subtitle: Find a shared interest. Agree on the same day.
ending: Our calendars finally agree: Saturday, two in the afternoon. I found something in common and caught a small misunderstanding before it became an empty table.

scenes.title: The kettle conference
scenes.speaker: chen
paragraphs: At school, I reach the kettle at the same time as Chen, a colleague with round glasses and a precarious stack of books. I remember Ms Lin’s invitation for Saturday. Perhaps these two plans can become one.

line.pinyin: nǐ zhōu mò yǒu kōng ma ？

scenes.clue: Tell Chen you are free on Saturday.

choices.label: Tell Chen you are free on Saturday.
choices.hint: Listen again and look for the part that answers the question.

responseLine.pinyin: tài hǎo le ！ wǒ yě yǒu kōng 。

options.richPinyin: wǒ xīng qī liù yǒu kōng

options.feedback: He is asking about availability, not your job.

scenes.title: Something in common
scenes.speaker: chen
paragraphs: Chen sets down the books and tells me how he likes to relax. We may have something in common. I listen for his favourite activity before replying.

line.english: I like drinking tea. What about you?
line.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan hē chá 。 nǐ ne ？

scenes.clue: Listen for his interest, then say you share it.

choices.label: Listen for his interest, then say you share it.
choices.hint: Listen for his interest, then say you share it.

responseLine.english: Then let’s go for tea together!
responseLine.pinyin: nà wǒ men yì qǐ qù hē chá ba ！

options.simplePinyin: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē chá
options.richPinyin: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē chá

options.richPinyin: wǒ yě xǐ huan kàn shū 。

aside.answer: Chen sets down the books and tells me how he likes to relax. We may have something in common. I listen for his favourite activity before replying.

scenes.title: Two calendars, two days
scenes.speaker: chen
paragraphs: I show Chen the teahouse on a map. He types a day into his phone: Sunday. I meant Saturday. One of us will have a very lonely cup of tea if I only smile now.
scenes.clue: Correct the day: Saturday, not Sunday.

choices.label: Correct the day: Saturday, not Sunday.
choices.hint: Listen again and look for the part that answers the question.

responseLine.zh: 哦，星期六！下午两点，可以吗？
responseLine.english: Oh, Saturday! Is two in the afternoon okay?
responseLine.pinyin: ò ， xīng qī liù ！ xià wǔ liǎng diǎn ， kě yǐ ma ？

options.simplePinyin: shì xīng qī liù bú shì xīng qī tiān
options.richPinyin: shì xīng qī liù bú shì xīng qī tiān

options.feedback: That agrees to Sunday. Check the day on his screen.
options.simplePinyin: duì ， xīng qī tiān jiàn 。
options.richPinyin: duì ， xīng qī tiān jiàn 。

options.feedback: That says you are busy on Saturday, which is your planned day.
options.simplePinyin: xīng qī liù wǒ méi yǒu kōng 。
options.richPinyin: xīng qī liù wǒ méi yǒu kōng 。

aside.question: Recall this moment
aside.answer: I show Chen the teahouse on a map. He types a day into his phone: Sunday. I meant Saturday. One of us will have a very lonely cup of tea if I only smile now.

scenes.title: Say it once more
scenes.speaker: chen
paragraphs: Two o’clock works. We save the same map pin, and Chen corrects his calendar. The bell rings before I put away my phone. One final sentence can hold the whole plan together.

line.pinyin: hǎo ， wǒ men shén me shí hòu jiàn ？

scenes.clue: Confirm that you will meet on Saturday at two in the afternoon.

choices.label: Confirm that you will meet on Saturday at two in the afternoon.

simple.english: Let’s meet on Saturday at two in the afternoon.

rich.english: Let’s meet on Saturday at two in the afternoon.

choices.hint: Put the day before 下午两点, then 见. 吧 finishes the suggestion.

responseLine.english: Great! See you Saturday at two in the afternoon!
responseLine.pinyin: hǎo ！ xīng qī liù xià wǔ liǎng diǎn jiàn ！

aside.question: Recall this moment
aside.answer: Two o’clock works. We save the same map pin, and Chen corrects his calendar. The bell rings before I put away my phone. One final sentence can hold the whole plan together.

title: One more cup
subtitle: Introduce two people. Let the afternoon change.
ending: Ms Zhou refills the pot. Rain has changed the plan, but it has given us one more conversation. When I leave, there will already be a reason to come back.

scenes.title: The right table
scenes.speaker: zhou
paragraphs: I arrive at the neighbourhood teahouse. Chen is looking for a table; Ms Lin has found the best chair. Ms Zhou explains what she can serve today. I listen before ordering.

line.zh: 你好！今天只有热茶，想喝一杯吗？
line.english: Hello! Today we only have hot tea. Would you like a cup?
line.pinyin: nǐ hǎo ！ jīn tiān zhǐ yǒu rè chá ， xiǎng hē yì bēi ma ？

scenes.clue: Listen for the drink available today, then order it.

choices.label: Listen for the drink available today, then order it.

rich.english: I would like a cup of hot tea.

choices.hint: Listen for the drink available today, then order it.

options.richPinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi rè chá

scenes.title: A word under the rain
scenes.speaker: zhou
paragraphs: Chen shows us his book. Just as we begin talking about a walk, rain drums on the roof. Ms Zhou moves a chair away from the doorway and speaks over the noise. I need to hear that again.

line.english: It is raining. Wait a little before leaving.
line.pinyin: xià yǔ le 。 děng yí xià zài zǒu ba 。

scenes.clue: Politely ask Ms Zhou to repeat what she said.

choices.label: Politely ask Ms Zhou to repeat what she said.
choices.hint: Listen again and look for the part that answers the question.

responseLine.zh: 下雨了。你们可以在这里等一下。
responseLine.english: It is raining. You can wait here a little.
responseLine.pinyin: xià yǔ le 。 nǐ men kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ děng yí xià 。

options.simplePinyin: qǐng zài shuō yí biàn
options.richPinyin: qǐng zài shuō yí biàn

options.feedback: That proposes leaving now. You need to hear her suggestion again first.

scenes.title: One more cup
scenes.speaker: chen
paragraphs: The courtyard stones darken. Chen looks at the rain, then the nearly empty teapot. We can turn our walk into a longer conversation. Ms Zhou is already lifting the kettle.

line.pinyin: wǒ men xiàn zài zǒu ma ？

scenes.clue: Suggest staying here a little and having tea together.

choices.label: Suggest staying here a little and having tea together.

rich.english: Let’s wait here a little and have tea together.
